articles.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
articles.snippet: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

articles.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
articles.snippet: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.
